semiconductor_relevance: High — Sumitomo Chemical is a significant supplier of essential materials used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sumitomo Chemical Co., Ltd. is a prominent supplier in the semiconductor industry, focusing on the development and provision of critical semiconductor materials. Their product range includes photoresists, IC process wet chemicals, and PVD materials, which are vital for the fabrication of integrated circuits and other electronic components.
capabilities: PVD materials for thin film deposition
